mechanism: Alcohol induces CYP2E1 metabolism of acetaminophen, increasing formation of toxic metabolite N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine (NAPQI), and alcohol itself depletes hepatic glutathione stores needed for detoxification.
action: Advise patients to avoid concurrent use or limit acetaminophen to <2g/day and alcohol consumption; monitor liver function in chronic users of both substances.
